summary: The A4 prefill now covers every prefill row, not only steps of 1,536 tokens or more: short prompts prefill up to 11% faster
compatibility: Only with B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS set (prefill-activations a4); decode stays W4A16.
details: The b12x MoE now chooses the precision by row type: decode and MTP verification rows run W4A16 and prefill rows run A4, whatever the step size, so a prompt's precision no longer depends on how the scheduler batches it. Steps replayed from a CUDA graph keep W4A16.

GLM-5.3-Flash glm53-tp2 on two RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: a 1,154-token prompt prefilled at 6,498 instead of 5,868 tok/s; 8K/32K prefill and decode unchanged; needle-checksum 492, 492, 490 of 500 against 490, 492, 497.
